```sql
WITH
anc_stats AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    year,
    NULLIF(anc4_completed, 0) AS completed,
    NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS registered
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
    AND source = 'synthetic Bihar ANC fixture'
    AND year IN (2021, 2023)
),
pp_change AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    (completed::FLOAT / registered) * 100 AS pp_2021,
    FIRST_VALUE((completed::FLOAT / registered) * 100) OVER (PARTITION BY district ORDER BY year) AS pp_2023
  FROM anc_stats
)
SELECT
  district,
  pp_2023 - pp_2021 AS anc_percentage_point_increase
FROM pp_change
WHERE year = 2023;
```
